sense: a basic substance: the four elements; a chemical element

terms.gloss: an element, a first principle of matter
terms.comment: Classically the four elements of which all things are made, fire, air, water and earth, mostly in the plural; the chemists kept the word for the elements of their table. Its other everyday senses are the letters of the alphabet and the first principles of a subject, the ABC (prīma elementa; see alphabet and basic).

phrases.latin: nec dē elementīs videō dubitārī quattuor esse ea
phrases.english: nor do I see any doubt that the elements are four

sources: Classical quotations checked against the Perseus and Latin Library texts.
